title: EBM Audit external worker protocol v2

AuditCaseConfigurationDigestPreimage.$comment: The complete canonical, truth-free auditor configuration for one benchmark case. Each operation matrix binds explicitly to one execution-only AnalysisSpec and ordinal. Several matrices may bind the same spec only as configuration/digest representation; execution fails closed until F0 implements one grouped operation owner per unique case/spec with canonically sorted matrix aliases. It is distinct from the raw generator ResolvedGeneratorConfiguration and its digest domain.

ProjectSyntheticCandidateProvenance.$comment: The core's live opaque input owner authenticates issuance. The subprocess verifies only deterministic code, descriptor, catalog, and closed-record hashes; no signature or credential subsystem is implied.

ArtifactBinding.$comment: A fitted artifact that supports participant staging carries the exact creating chain's stage-model-reference digest. Null is reserved for artifacts with no stage-capable model.

CandidateProvenanceBinding.$comment: Core-owned request binding for one sealed prepared candidate. Project-owned synthetic provenance must match these independent outer fields before worker delegation.

ExecutionInputProjection.$comment: This projection is a repeatability contract for a trusted local worker. The backend callback and worker shell share one process, so it does not claim hostile-code isolation. Validate and fit carry the identical object and digest; attempt identity is bound separately by the fit scientific request.

BackendFitScientificInput.$comment: The attempt identifier and ordinal are scientific inputs in protocol v2. The fit request UUID is deterministically derived from the attempt identity, while that redundant UUID and the timestamp remain excluded from the scientific digest.

RetryEquivalentBackendFitScientificInput.$comment: The complete fit scientific input after removing exactly payload.attempt_id and payload.attempt_ordinal. No other scientific field is omitted.

RetryEquivalentFitRequestProjection.$comment: Closed owner for ebm-audit/retry-equivalence/1. It is derived from the complete ScientificFitRequestProjection after the four existing transport exclusions, then removes only payload.attempt_id and payload.attempt_ordinal.

AdapterSemantics.$comment: Transport-neutral maintained adapter semantics. It deliberately excludes worker executable/code and worker wire-version identities.

ClosedSettingsSchema.$comment: This recursive inline subset deliberately excludes $ref, $dynamicRef, $defs, anchors, applicator unions, conditionals, patternProperties, unevaluatedProperties, content schemas, and every unknown keyword. No schema retrieval is permitted. After shape validation, describe validation MUST recursively execute settings-schema-required-subset-of-properties/1 and reject every required name absent from the same object's properties map.

CommandEvidenceProjection.$comment: Active internal contract-harness command evidence. Separate stage command evidence is not active.

AuthenticatedWorkerRequestEvidenceProjec.$comment: Exact active command matrix. Validate and fit carry null planning_summary_id only for test-only contract-harness evidence, or the exact digest of sealed Universe/3 preparation authority for production evidence. The null branch has no promotion or product authority; stage has no active branch.

AuthenticatedWorkerExecutionEvidenceProj.$comment: Exact active execution matrix. Describe and self-test have null command evidence; validate/fit bind typed success or negative evidence and distinguish test-only contract-harness evidence from production evidence by planning_summary_id. The null branch has no promotion or product authority; stage has no active branch.
